CustomField.description: Populated by Analytics when IBC_Low_Fill_Rate_Case_Trigger__c is checked. Includes information about Inbound Calls product Fill Rate and Monetization rate for that Account. Used by Flow, Account_IBCLowFillRate_CreateCase_LowFillRate, to fill out the case description of "Inbound Calls - Issue Outreach" cases.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Populated by Analytics when Inbound Calls has either low fill rate or mrate. Includes fill rate/mrate percentages.
